observations: Quality: each trap is removed where it starts. The install check costs one node start (216 ms) and ci already installs first; the 22 moved guards now share childEnv, and the tools that cannot import from test/ keep their own drop, as the item says.

The rules guard covers test files only, by design: a non-test helper such as plugins/harness/test/helpers.mjs may still drop the variable inline without the guard noticing; none does today. A drop spelt by building the name at run time (as this folder does) also passes the guard.

The skeleton's test slot is the folder verify/<item>/, a placeholder: left as is the gate would try to run a folder, so the verifier must name a file. The gate refuses an unfilled skeleton either way.
